sheetsIndicative.note: one worksheet ('Sheet1'): header Call Sign,Status then 139,758 data rows. This is the sparsest export shape held - just two columns, with no licence class, no dates and no prefix/suffix decomposition. Status vocabulary Allocated (84,690), Reserved (49,624), Forbidden (5,431), Available (3), Quarantine (1) and blank (9). Distinctively, the 5,431 Forbidden values are folded into the Call Sign column (5,430 full callsign-shaped, mostly 20-series intermediate callsigns built on withheld suffixes, plus one bare three-letter suffix 'ZBX') rather than isolated in a separate sheet.

raw-extract-sheet-1-sheet1.csv.contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the single sheet; header Call Sign,Status then 139,758 rows. Anomalies preserved verbatim: two Values are lower-case (g0jrk, mogfs); 'G5 ZZ' has an interior space; 811 four-character Values (two-letter-suffix heritage series), five six-character (2E1BGN, 2E1DLR, 2E1EXP, GI0OXB, GI4OKU) and one seven-character (M/K2BBC, a reciprocal form); thirteen Values occur twice. No non-breaking spaces are present.

normalised--sheet-1-sheet1.csv.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class; 139,758 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning - not callsign-sorted; 13 duplicate callsigns on the record). Status carried verbatim (Allocated/Reserved/Forbidden/Available/Quarantine and 9 blanks preserved); licence_class is required-present-empty (the source discloses no class). Nothing was trimmed (no non-breaking spaces); lower-case forms and the interior-space 'G5 ZZ' are preserved verbatim. The 5,431 Forbidden values are folded into the callsign column verbatim, not reshaped into a suffix list.
